notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for fan-out of one queued timestamped directed interaction to multiple target recipients after the producing federate resigns. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the C++ standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies independent target-object routing, recipient time-advance servicing, retention after source resignation, the standard post-resignation retraction boundary, and exactly one directed receive callback per eligible recipient with preserved target, payload, tag, producer, timestamp, order, transport, and retraction metadata before each recipient grant. DDM, provider-specific names, registries, headers, and implementation behavior remain outside this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual MessageRetractionHandle sendDirectedInteraction( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass, ObjectInstanceHandle const & objectInstance, ParameterHandleValueMap const & parameterValues, VariableLengthData const & userSuppliedTag, LogicalTime const & time) = 0
